items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, by default it only handles types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level since it allows combined usage with other general purpose decoders without conflicts. Alternative constructors with a Predicate<ResolvableType> parameter can be used to customize this behavior.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，默认情况下仅处理在类型或泛型级别上标注了@Serializable的类型，因为它允许与其他通用解码器结合使用且不会产生冲突。可以使用带有参数的替代构造函数来自定义此行为。

items.source: Returns the serializer that can (de)serialize instances of the given type. If no serializer can be found, or if resolvableType is a open polymorphic type, null is returned.
items.translation: 返回可用于序列化或反序列化给定类型实例的序列化器。如果找不到序列化器，或者resolvableType是开放多态类型，则返回null。

items.source: Creates a new instance with the given format and supported mime types which only encode types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 创建具有给定格式和仅对指定谓词返回 `true` 的编码类型的支持 MIME 类型的实例。

items.source: Creates a new instance with the given format and supported mime types which only handle types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 创建具有给定格式和仅处理在类型或泛型级别上标注了`@Serializable`的mime类型的mimeType的新实例。

items.source:
Indicates whether the given type can be serialized using Kotlin
serialization.
items.translation: 指示是否可以使用 Kotlin 序列化给定类型。
返回支持的 MIME 类型。
mimeType - 要使用的 MIME 类型（可以为 null）

items.source: true if type can be serialized; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果 type 可序列化；否则为 false

items.source: resolvableType - the type to find a serializer for
items.translation: resolvableType - 要查找序列化器的类型

items.source: a resolved serializer for the given type, or null
items.translation: 给定类型的已解析序列化器，或null

items.source:
Returns the serializer that can (de)serialize instances of the given
type.
items.translation: 返回可以序列化（反序列化）给定类型实例的序列化器。
